About this item
Versatile and Convenient: Our set of 4 glass overnight oats containers with bamboo lids and spoons is perfect for a variety of uses. Whether you're preparing overnight oats, enjoying a refreshing iced coffee or cappuccino, or even storing your favorite cereal or yogurt, these containers have got you covered. The high-quality crystal glass ensures durability, while the natural bamboo lids add a touch of natural atmosphere
Safe and Healthy: We prioritize your health and well-being, which is why our containers are made from BPA-free and lead-free materials. The stainless steel spoons provided are also safe for use. Rest assured that your food and drinks remain fresh and uncontaminated, thanks to the airtight seal provided by the bamboo lids with silicone seal ring .
Practical and Functional: Our containers hold up to 14oz of liquid, making them the ideal size for your morning smoothie, fruit juice, or tea. They are also perfect for meal prepping, allowing you to easily portion out your breakfast or snacks. With their stylish vintage design, they are not only suitable for home use but also make a great addition to any kitchen, restaurant, bar, or coffee shop.
Thoughtful Gift Option: Looking for the perfect gift? Our glass mugs with bamboo lids and spoons make an excellent choice. Whether it's for a housewarming party, a birthday celebration, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Christmas, or Thanksgiving, this set is sure to impress. Show your loved ones how much you care by giving them a practical and elegant gift that they can enjoy every day.
Easy to Clean and Maintain: Cleaning our glass containers is a breeze, as they are dishwasher safe. The high-quality materials used ensure that the containers maintain their clarity and shine over time. The bamboo lids and spoons can be wiped clean with ease. Invest in our durable and easy-to-maintain glass mugs for a hassle-free and enjoyable dining experience.
